newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet rises as NYMEX gains offset weak diffs.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet rises as NYMEX gains offset weak diffs.

text.p: U.S. prompt jet fuel prices widened moderately on Monday as stronger May heating oil futures more than offset weaker differentials in both New York Harbor and the Gulf Coast, traders said.

New York Harbor 54-grade jet fuel was offered at 3.75 cents above the May print, about 0.25 cent weaker than diffs seen late last week, while Gulf diffs slumped a half cent to offers of 0.75 cent above the screen, traders said.
"There weren't many buyers," one Gulf player said, adding diffs seemed to be weakening toward their normal seasonal spread of about two cents above cash heating oil.
